
```{python}
with open("../../homework/hw5/hw5_raw.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    lwf_lines = f.readlines()

while not lwf_lines[0].startswith("*** START"):
    lwf_lines = lwf_lines[1:]
lwf_lines = lwf_lines[1:]

while not lwf_lines[0].startswith("_"):
    lwf_lines = lwf_lines[1:]
lwf_lines = lwf_lines[1:]

while not lwf_lines[-1].startswith("*** END"):
    lwf_lines = lwf_lines[:-1]
lwf_lines = lwf_lines[:-1]

lwf_text = "".join(lwf_lines)
```
```{python}
acts = re.split(r"\nACT [IVXL]+", lwf_text)
acts = acts[1:]
```
```{python}
# 3. One row per word, with its chapter
rows = []
act_num = 0

for act in acts:
    act_num += 1
    lines = re.split(r"[\W_]+", act.lower())   # split on \W AND on _
    lines = [l for l in lines if l != ""]
    for l in lines:
        rows.append({"line": l, "act": act_num})

lwf_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
```
```{python}
# 4. Save it for next time
lwf_df.to_csv("lwf_words.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
```
